company.name: Elyos AI
company.shortDescription: Elyos AI provides autonomous AI agents for trades and field services, automating communications, booking, dispatch, and follow-ups.
company.description: Elyos AI offers a suite of autonomous AI agents that automate customer communications and operations for trades and field service companies. Its platform handles inbound calls, schedules appointments, manages reminders, supports sales follow-ups, and assists field engineers by updating job details and reducing administrative work. The AI agents integrate with existing CRM and job management systems to book jobs, confirm appointments, and streamline scheduling with minimal human intervention. Elyos AI also provides tools that engage customers via voice and messaging, helping businesses respond to enquiries and manage workflows consistently. The company’s solutions aim to reduce manual workload and improve responsiveness in service-oriented operations.
